facts.en: Paid homewares shop assistant at Fictional Tealwindow Goods from 2018-03 to 2022-07.
facts.zh: 2018-03 至 2022-07 在虚构青窗家居用品店任有薪门店助理。

facts.en: Completed a non-award evening introduction to flower handling at Fictional Petalwick Centre in 2022-09.
facts.zh: 2022-09 在虚构花瓣芯中心完成不授予资格的夜间花材处理入门课程。

facts.en: Paid preparation assistant at Fictional Honeyscript Flowers from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构蜜字花店任有薪备料助理。

facts.en: Checked incoming stem bundles against supplier descriptions and the shop lead’s order list.
facts.zh: 依据供应商描述及门店负责人订单清单核对到店花枝捆。

facts.en: Labeled buckets with received dates and moved approved stock to the locations specified by the florist.
facts.zh: 为花桶标注收件日期，并将获批花材移至花艺师指定位置。

facts.en: Prepared wrapping paper, ribbon lengths and order-message cards from the florist’s assembly sheet.
facts.zh: 依据花艺师组装单准备包装纸、丝带长度及订单留言卡。

facts.en: Assembled small hand-tied orders to the florist’s existing recipe and referred requested substitutions to the florist.
facts.zh: 按花艺师现有配方组装小型手绑花束订单，并将替换请求转交花艺师。

facts.en: The florist selected arrangement designs and signed off customer-specific colour substitutions.
facts.zh: 花艺师选择花艺设计，并批准客户特定颜色替换。

facts.en: Matched completed orders to collection names and recorded when each order left the shop.
facts.zh: 将已完成订单与取货姓名匹配，并记录各订单离店时间。

facts.en: Helped test a message-card check on 18 fictional order examples in 2025-04.
facts.zh: 2025-04 使用 18 个虚构订单示例协助测试留言卡核对流程。

facts.en: Personally checked spelling against supplied customer text; the shop lead reviewed delivery-date handling.
facts.zh: 个人依据提供的客户文字核对拼写；门店负责人审核配送日期处理。

facts.en: A 2025-06 work sample contains 25 packed orders, 24 with the message card attached and 1 explicitly ordered without a card.
facts.zh: 一份 2025-06 工作抽样包含 25 份已包装订单，24 份附留言卡，1 份明确要求不附卡。

facts.en: That sample does not show a missing-card error for the card-free order or a total monthly order volume.
facts.zh: 该抽样未显示免卡订单存在漏卡错误，亦未显示月度订单总量。

facts.en: Uses supplier packing lists, label templates and a shared collection calendar.
facts.zh: 使用供应商装箱单、标签模板及共享取货日历。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Cloverpaper Community Meals during 2021-02 to 2023-06.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2023-06 在虚构三叶草纸社区餐食团体做志愿者。

facts.en: For that group, made reusable table-number holders from card and maintained a box of clean display materials.
facts.zh: 为该团体使用卡纸制作可重复使用的桌号架，并维护一箱清洁展示材料。

facts.en: Arranged dried leaves and paper flowers for a personal family celebration in 2024; no client payment was received.
facts.zh: 2024 年为个人家庭庆祝活动布置干叶及纸花；未收取客户报酬。

facts.en: Enjoys making botanical-looking paper collages from invented plant shapes.
facts.zh: 爱好使用虚构植物形状制作仿植物纸艺拼贴。

facts.en: In the earlier homewares role, tracked gift-wrap supplies and prepared customer collection bags.
facts.zh: 在较早的家居用品岗位中跟踪礼品包装用品，并准备客户取货袋。

facts.en: No independently commissioned wedding-floristry project is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录独立承接的婚礼花艺项目。

facts.en: Left written handovers for uncollected orders, pending substitutions and depleted wrapping stock.
facts.zh: 为未领取订单、待定替换及耗尽的包装用品留下书面交接。
